caption: The drawing depicts a formal outfit consisting of a long, dark green coat decorated with elaborate embroidery, primarily in shades of purple, lavender, green, white, and yellow, featuring floral and leaf patterns along the edges, cuffs, pockets, and collar. The coat has a high, stiff collar and is worn over a pale vest with similar floral embroidery and a white shirt with an upright collar. Dark green breeches match the color of the coat and complete the ensemble. The main focus is the richly embroidered coat viewed from the front, while in the upper right corner, there is a simplified line drawing of the same coat seen from the back, showing the placement of the embroidery on the rear and cuffs. The background is plain and beige, and there are no additional objects or details beyond the clothing depicted.
title: Suit
